text: Binary per-row flag from the `argument` column only (the OP's own explanation text): 1 if the OP's own current text contains at least one explicit hedging or self-doubt marker about their own claims or view (e.g., "I might be wrong", "I'm not sure", "to my knowledge", "I guess", "perhaps", admitting possible error or uncertainty); 0 if the argument is assessable and has no such explicit marker. Ignore hedges inside quotations or reported positions of others unless the OP adopts them. Exclude, and do not use as evidence, OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (e.g., "EDIT: view changed", "Δ"); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not outcome reporting and may be kept. Do not reconstruct an initial version. Output null if the argument is missing or malformed.
